text: Another dedicated ride to LEO is coming soon for synspective 🦉 🛰️ Electron will lift off this week from Launch Complex 1 to deliver the 12th StriX synthetic aperture radar satellite to space and continue the expansion of their Earth-monitoring constellation. "Owl By The Dozen" launch window opens: 🚀 3:15pm NZST, Sept 19 🚀 03:15 UTC, Sept 19 🚀 12:15 pm JST, Sept 19 🚀 11:15 pm EDT, Sept 18 🚀 8:15 pm PDT, Sept 18
